headline: 5 Solana program IDs catalogued for Meteora Vaults and related programs; EVM address schema prevents admin_addresses[] population; audit PDFs blocked by Google Drive login wall.

findings.text: Solana has no Etherscan-style name-tag search endpoint. SolanaCompass project page (fetched) lists 8 Meteora programs with on-chain activity; the Dynamic Vaults program ID 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi is confirmed by both SolanaCompass and the vault-sdk GitHub README. Additional program IDs surfaced: LBUZKhRxPF3XUpBCjp4YzTKgLccjZhTSDM9YuVaPwxo (DLMM), MERLuDFBMmsHnsBPZw2sDQZHvXFMwp8EdjudcU2HKky (Mercurial Stable Swap / Multi-token Stable Pools), FEESngU3neckdwib9X3KWqdL7Mjmqk9XNp3uh5JbP4KP (M3M3/Fee Sharing). No EVM-chain explorers apply.

Official docs site is docs.meteora.ag (confirmed via SolanaCompass links and vault-sdk README referencing docs.mercurial.finance). No dedicated deployed-contracts page URL was successfully fetched this run — docs.meteora.ag sub-pages were not in the pre-approved fetch list and the app.meteora.ag/vaults fetch returned only JS-rendered metadata. Protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to docs.mercurial.finance as the historical SDK docs reference; downstream runs should attempt docs.meteora.ag/for-developers/dynamic-vaults/integration.

Both audit PDFs on protocol.audit_links (Google Drive IDs 1CjdMl7LhJisnI1LTrAFt2Bvi5ahqq1yc and 1cJ2ZH23yj9uO1otR2pLDQ1MP3OJm84IW) returned Google Drive login walls — document bodies not accessible. Titles visible from metadata: 'Mercurial Finance - Final Report.pdf' and 'Mercurial_Finance_Vault_Dynamic_AMM_Solana_Program_Security_Audit.pdf'. Audit firms inferred from medium article (Zellic, Bramah Systems) but not confirmed from the PDFs themselves. No in-scope addresses extractable.

GitHub org MeteoraAg confirmed via search and fetch (github.com/MeteoraAg). Repo MeteoraAg/vault-sdk fetched; README lists vault Program ID: 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi. Anchor.toml shows localnet-only ID Fg6PaFpoGXkYsidMpWTK6W2BeZ7FEfcYkg476zPFsLnS (not mainnet). No pinnable commit SHA available (branch 'main' only in fetch, no raw SHA returned). No broadcast JSON or hardhat-deploy artifacts found in this repo. Other SDK repos listed: damm-v2, dynamic-bonding-curve, dlmm-sdk, alpha-vault-sdk, vault-sdk.
Protocol is Solana-only per protocol.chains. Only one chain; D5 multi-chain enumeration not applicable.

Dynamic Vaults program 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi uses Solana PDA (program-derived account) architecture — individual vault accounts are derived per-token and are not enumerable via a single view call. The DeFiPunkd read API only supports EVM chainIds (1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111); Solana (chain ID not in supported list) cannot be queried. D6 factory-child enumeration not performable this run.

Role taxonomy applied: 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi = vault (program); LBUZKhRxPF3XUpBCjp4YzTKgLccjZhTSDM9YuVaPwxo = other (DLMM program, not vaults-specific); MERLuDFBMmsHnsBPZw2sDQZHvXFMwp8EdjudcU2HKky = pool (Mercurial Stable Swap, legacy); FEESngU3neckdwib9X3KWqdL7Mjmqk9XNp3uh5JbP4KP = other (fee-sharing/M3M3 program). MET token METvsvVRapdj9cFLzq4Tr43xK4tAjQfwX76z3n6mWQL = token. All actor_class = unknown (Solana programs, not EVM multisig/timelock constructs).

All 5 program IDs trace to fetched sources: 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi from both vault-sdk README (github.com/MeteoraAg/vault-sdk) and SolanaCompass; LBUZKhRxPF3XUpBCjp4YzTKgLccjZhTSDM9YuVaPwxo from SolanaCompass and bitquery.io search result; MERLuDFBMmsHnsBPZw2sDQZHvXFMwp8EdjudcU2HKky from SolanaCompass; FEESngU3neckdwib9X3KWqdL7Mjmqk9XNp3uh5JbP4KP from SolanaCompass; MET token from SolanaCompass. All trace to fetched evidence. Note: admin_addresses[] cannot be populated because the JSON schema requires EVM 0x-format addresses — Solana base58 program IDs are recorded in evidence[] and unknowns[] instead.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the MeteoraAg/vault-sdk GitHub repo, SolanaCompass project page, and search results. 5 Solana program IDs were catalogued with citations. grade=unknown because (a) Solana program IDs cannot be placed in admin_addresses[] due to EVM-only address schema constraint, (b) audit PDFs were blocked by Google Drive authentication walls, (c) DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana, preventing on-chain state verification, and (d) no deployed-contracts documentation page was successfully fetched.

protocol_metadata.about: Meteora Dynamic Vaults is a yield aggregator on Solana (originally Mercurial Finance) that allows users and integrated protocols to deposit single-token assets (e.g. USDC, SOL) into vault accounts managed by program 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi. Deposited assets are automatically distributed to vetted Solana lending platforms (Kamino, Solend, Marginfi) and rebalanced approximately once per minute by an off-chain keeper called Hermes to pursue the highest available yield. Vault depositors receive LP tokens representing their share, earning lending interest plus any trading fees from integrated AMM pools (DAMM v1) that route idle liquidity through the vaults. The protocol is the yield layer underpinning Meteora's broader DAMM v1 AMM product suite.
